subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a one-line activity summary, and root policy treats new public config/lifecycle surfaces as high-bar decisions that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option while preserving the current one-line collapse lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep one-line collapse only
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep the current compact activity summary behavior.

options.title: Fold into structured progress cards
options.body: Defer this into a broader cross-channel structured progress-card design that can represent checklist state consistently.

recommendation.title: Add default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option while preserving the current one-line collapse lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Telegram collapse-summary and finalization commits are closest to the lifecycle policy this issue would extend.
